title: I can't find a way to connect another device to xDrip+
body:
Today I managed to connect xDrip+ on my Android phone with Miao Miao that got delivered to me today. 

On the Miao Miao official website it says "As well, MiaoMiao’s APP integrations allow for multiple family members to log in and monitor your data.", put I can't find a way to do that in xDrip+. I've been looking for around 20 minutes in the settings of the app.

Can anyone help?

comments.body:
@dominic29  One of xDrip's strong points is sharing. A couple of ways:
1) set up a Nightscout site, upload your xDrip data, and anyone can log into your site to see your numbers.
2) set up a sync group and members of your group can install xDrip+ on their Android and see the exact same thing you see on your copy of xDrip+
3) on the long shot that you have a Dexcom account, you can set up Dexcom Share partners
4) Set up a Tidepool account and upload to it. Your followers just need to have access to your account name and password to access the data.

These are just a few of the ways to make your Data accessible. There are several more.
